events.narrate: Bhopal, 2026. Deepak, mausam vaigyanik. Aur shauk se engineer.

events.say: Yeh mera weather station hai. Garmi, hawa, UV, aur magnetic field.
LoRa. Pachaas kilometre tak baat karta hai.

events.narrate: Har zile mein ek station. Har pachaas kilometre par.
Ek saal mein, poore Madhya Pradesh mein uske stations jag uthe.
Har station apna data agle ko bhejta, aur sab Bhopal pahunchta.
Par data kuch ajeeb keh raha tha.
UV badh raha tha. Ozone ghat rahi thi. Aur dharti ka magnetic field bhi.

stick_screen.title: Forum · r/geomagnetism
posts: Anyone else seeing the field drop this fast? My magnetometer shows -2% this year.
Satellite ozone over the tropics is falling too. Some models say gone by 2100.
My 133 stations in Madhya Pradesh show the same. Something big is happening.

events.narrate: Raat bhar Deepak forum padhta raha.
Aur use samajh aaya: yeh sirf MP ki baat nahi thi.
